issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath v2.0.0 section 4.1 literals and FHIR date/dateTime lexical forms
issues.evidence: Forced C++ vs Python DuckDB matrix showed Python fallback fhirpath_date returned padded dates for true, 3.14, and partial dates while C++ returned NULL or preserved precision.
issues.root_cause: Python fhirpath_date_udf used string length only and invented month/day components without digit/range validation.
issues.resolution: Added _normalize_fhir_date_string with digit, month/day, leap-year, and DateTime full-date checks; partial date precision is preserved.
issues.verified_in: forced backend matrix; pytest fhir4ds/; conformance run_all.py
